title: Planned procurement register
status: Planning baseline only. No purchase or financial commitment is authorised by this register.

policy.per_transaction_limit: To be specified and approved for each item
policy.monthly_limit: To be specified and approved for each item
policy.public_disclosure: Publish purpose, vendor, quoted cost, approved cap, status and outcome; never publish credentials or private financial access.

entries.purpose: Obtain scans, certified copies, plans, deeds, court and authority records that close high-value ownership, parcel-boundary and chronology gaps.
entries.timing: As a specific research gap and holder are established
conditions: Identify the exact record and why it matters
Confirm holder, reproduction terms and rights
Obtain written quote and delivery specification
Owner approval before ordering

entries.item: Canonical catalogue backup, export and validation
entries.purpose: Protect the source record, preserve provenance and provide tested recovery. Audit existing Cloudflare, GitHub and backup capacity before considering additional services.
entries.timing: After existing provision and failure modes are audited
conditions: Do not create another competing database
Use a documented export/restore test
Verify retention, privacy and access controls
Price only a demonstrated gap

entries.item: Documentary bible, master script and historical/rights review
entries.purpose: Develop the complete source-linked account of the estate, family matriarchy, history and heritage before scene production.
conditions: Complete source ledger and scene sequence
Retain contradictory evidence and corrections
Confirm archive/image/music/voice rights
Review the deliverable and quote before approval

entries.purpose: Produce sequential nominal two-minute scenes with screenwriting, set/prop/wardrobe design, choreography, camera, sound, edit, grade and subtitles.
entries.timing: One approved scene at a time after pre-production
conditions: Verify official or licensed model access and terms
Verify commercial rights, consent and data handling
Run a quality test and cost per approved scene
Specify per-scene and monthly cap before any commitment

entries.purpose: Explain the historic landscape, parcels, built environment and proposed reconstruction with transparent source/uncertainty labels.
entries.timing: After the parcel and source datasets are stable enough for a pilot
conditions: Use source-linked survey/plan data
Label conjectural reconstruction clearly
Test a small pilot before scaling
Confirm software and content rights

entries.item: Search visibility, email, social assets and documentary distribution
entries.purpose: Reach readers, contributors, heritage partners and documentary audiences through measured channels.
entries.timing: Organic and existing tools first; paid activity only after measured need
conditions: Set a measurable audience/conversion outcome
Use existing owned channels first
Quote, cap and cancellation terms before paid tools
No external campaign spend without approval

entries.item: Site, planning, environmental, architectural and museum feasibility
entries.purpose: Assess candidate land/site, legal title, planning, utilities, environmental suitability, reconstruction brief, exhibition and operating model.
entries.timing: Longer-term feasibility after a written scope and professional advice plan
conditions: Keep the proposal separate from Welsh title claims
No deposit, purchase or contract
Obtain local professional advice and clear deliverables
Stage as feasibility milestones with go/no-go decisions

entries.item: Welsh/English/Spanish translation, captions and accessible transcripts
entries.purpose: Make research and documentary material accessible across languages and abilities, with human review of historical terminology.
conditions: Define exact pages/scenes and language variants
Preserve historical names and source citations
Quote by word/minute and review cycle
Approve per release batch

notes: No verified vendor quotes have been entered yet.
The register is a planning and disclosure instrument, not purchasing authority.
Each approved commitment must be reflected in HubSpot and in the next public register version.
